messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Annex III, 1.5.4

1.5.4. Errors of fitting Errors likely to be made when fitting or refitting certain parts, which could be a source of risk, shall be made impossible by the design and construction of such parts or, failing this, by information given on the parts themselves or their housings. The same information shall be given on moving parts or their housings where the direction of movement needs to be known in order to avoid a risk. Where necessary, the instructions for use shall give further information on these risks. Where a faulty connection can be the source of risk, incorrect connections shall be made impossible by design or, failing this, by information given on the elements to be connected and, where appropriate, on the means of connection.

response.text:
Errors of fitting or refitting parts | shall be made impossible | by the design and construction of such parts | where the errors are likely and could be a source of risk | Errors likely to be made when fitting or refitting certain parts, which could be a source of risk, shall be made impossible by the design and construction of such parts
Fitting errors not prevented by design | shall be prevented by | information given on the parts themselves or their housings | failing design prevention | failing this, by information given on the parts themselves or their housings
Information on fitting direction | shall be given on | moving parts or their housings | where the direction of movement needs to be known in order to avoid a risk | The same information shall be given on moving parts or their housings where the direction of movement needs to be known in order to avoid a risk
Instructions for use | shall give | further information on these risks | where necessary | Where necessary, the instructions for use shall give further information on these risks
Incorrect connections | shall be made impossible | by design | where a faulty connection can be a source of risk | incorrect connections shall be made impossible by design
Incorrect connections not prevented by design | shall be prevented by | information given on the elements to be connected and, where appropriate, on the means of connection | failing design prevention | failing this, by information given on the elements to be connected and, where appropriate, on the means of connection
